name: effect-based-planning-gate

material.persisted_state_schema: Changes a database, migration, schema, generated state contract, or other persisted-state semantics.
material.public_external_contract: Changes a public API, external payload, webhook, wire contract, or backward-compatibility guarantee.
material.executable_auth_security_privacy: Changes executable authentication, authorization, security, secret handling, or privacy enforcement.
material.billing_accounting: Changes billing, charging, quota accounting, balances, pricing, or money semantics.
material.destructive_data_money_privacy: Introduces a credible data-loss, money-loss, privacy-leak, or destructive-operation risk.

boundary.provider_routing_wire_model_identity: Changes provider routing, provider wire behavior, externally meaningful model identity, or selection ownership.
boundary.deployment_topology_production_rollout_r: Changes deployment topology, production rollout behavior, process placement, or runtime ownership.
boundary.coordinated_cross_service_state: Requires coordinated state or contract changes across services or repositories.
boundary.complex_rollback: Cannot be reverted locally without coordinated migration, rollout, or state repair.

bounded_change.effect: When every required fact is proven and no hard effect is present or unresolved, cap the gate at light.

risk_groups.design: Material solution ambiguity, a new feature boundary, or an architectural decision.
risk_groups.reach: User/operator workflow or multi-module reach that is broader than a local presentation change.
risk_groups.runtime: Performance, load, async, scheduler, sync, session-state, relay, or degraded-runtime behavior.
risk_groups.proof_rollback: The critical behavior is difficult to prove locally or rollback is not a direct bounded revert.

unknowns.rule: Inspect repository evidence first. An unresolved possible hard effect requires a blocking question or full; other unknowns do not become extra risk groups.

lightweight.requirements: No present or unresolved hard effect, direct work, and no independent risk group.
lightweight.workflow: Implement or answer directly; no subagents, council, run artifacts, approved-plan artifact, or handoff.

light.requirements: No present or unresolved hard effect and either a proven bounded change or one to two independent risk groups.
light.workflow: Use a compact single-agent approach and focused proof/rollback in chat; no council, run artifacts, approved-plan artifact, or handoff.

full.requirements: Any present or unresolved hard effect, or at least three independent risk groups when the bounded-change cap is not proven.
full.workflow: Use the persisted multiagent Planning Loop, user-approved plan, and Planning to Programming handoff.

blocked-no-subagents.requirements: The classified gate is full and independent subagents are unavailable.

constraints: Classify effects, not keywords, filenames, repository names, or task labels.
Lines changed are not a standalone signal.
Provider-adjacent copy, labels, docs, metadata, and local config are not hard effects unless their executable contract changes.
Correlated concerns count once in their risk group.
